Returns a day-by-day delivery calendar for ONE specific subscription.

Each day in 'daily[]' has a 'status' field for frontend calendar colour-coding:
  • delivered    → order marked as delivered ✅ (GREEN)
  • undelivered  → past date, missed or cancelled ❌ (RED)
  • in_transit   → driver started trip, en-route 🚚 (AMBER)
  • pending      → order confirmed, not yet dispatched ⚪
  • scheduled    → future expected delivery 📅 (BLUE)
  • vacation     → paused/vacation range 🏖️ (ORANGE)
  • skipped      → customer-requested skip date ⚫
  • off_day      → frequency doesn't include this day (LIGHT GREY)
  • not_active   → outside subscription start/end period

Also returns a 'summary' block with monthly aggregate counts.
Accessible by: Admin and the owning Customer.

item.name: 🆕 GET Monthly Delivery Calendar (All Subscriptions of Customer)

request.description:
Returns monthly delivery calendar across ALL subscriptions of a customer.

Response structure:
  • customer_id, customer_name, customer_email
  • overall_summary → aggregate counts across all subscriptions
  • subscriptions[] → per-subscription breakdown, each containing:
      - subscription_id, frequency, frequency_display, status
      - is_paused, pause_start, pause_end
      - items[] → products being delivered
      - summary → monthly counts for this subscription
      - daily[] → day-by-day calendar array

Day statuses in daily[]:
  • delivered    → ✅ GREEN
  • undelivered  → ❌ RED
  • in_transit   → 🚚 AMBER (driver started trip)
  • pending      → ⚪ GREY
  • scheduled    → 📅 BLUE (future, no order yet)
  • vacation     → 🏖️ ORANGE
  • skipped      → ⚫ DARK GREY
  • off_day      → light grey
  • not_active   → transparent

Useful for Admin: shows complete picture when customer has multiple subscriptions (e.g. milk + curd).
Connect using Postman WebSocket Request. Send: {"lat": 18.5, "lng": 73.8}
